relevance_reason: Reports infertile Chinese women with biallelic APC/C gene variants (CDC23, APC13) and oocyte maturation arrest, fertilization failure or early embryonic arrest, with functional studies. This is the phenotype the OZEMA entry covers. Only the abstract was available.

findings.statement: Cui et al. (2025) performed whole-exome sequencing in infertile women from 639 unrelated Chinese families. They identified 3 probands carrying APC/C gene variants. The infertility in these families was characterized by disturbed oocyte maturation, fertilization failure, and arrest of early embryonic development.
quotes: We conducted whole-exome sequencing of patients with female infertility from 639 unrelated Chinese families and three probands with APC/C gene mutations were screened.
female infertility characterized by disturbances in oocyte maturation, failure of fertilization, and cessation of early embryonic growth among three distinct Chinese familial lineages

findings.statement: In 2 unrelated Chinese women with infertility (cases 1 and 2), Cui et al. (2025) identified compound heterozygous missense variants in the CDC23 gene: c.A1277G, c.A833G, c.C182T, and c.C301T. The variants were found by whole-exome sequencing and followed a recessive inheritance pattern. The affected residues were conserved across species, and prediction programs (MutationTaster, SIFT, PolyPhen-2) suggested the variants were deleterious. In vitro studies suggested that the CDC23 variants caused dysregulated protein expression.
quotes: two compound heterozygous missense variants of CDC23 (c.A1277G, c.A833G, c.C182T and c.C301T) from case 1 and case 2
These APC/C gene mutations all showed a recessive inheritance pattern.
In vitro experimental data suggested that mutations associated with CDC23 result in dysregulated protein expression

findings.statement: In an infertile Chinese woman (case 3), Cui et al. (2025) identified compound heterozygous variants in the APC13 (ANAPC13) gene: c.C6A and c.116_126del. The variants were found by whole-exome sequencing and followed a recessive pattern. In vitro studies suggested that the APC13 missense variant caused abnormal cellular localization of the protein. Structural modeling suggested that the APC/C variants may alter chemical bonds with other APC/C subunits.
quotes: one compound heterozygous variant of APC13 (c.C6A and c.116_126del) from case 3
whereas missense mutation in APC13 is implicated in aberrant cellular localization patterns
Structural analysis indicated that these mutations may result in changes in the chemical bonds between themselves and other APC/C subunits.

relevance_reason: Reports homozygous CDC23 variants in infertile women with oocyte maturation defects, with functional studies and a mouse model, which defines OZEMA28.

findings.statement: Fan et al. (2023) described 3 infertile women with female infertility characterized by oocyte maturation defects.
quotes: responsible for female infertility characterized by oocyte maturation defects in three infertile individuals

findings.statement: In 3 infertile women with oocyte maturation defects, Fan et al. (2023) identified homozygous missense variants in the CDC23 gene, a core subunit of the anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome (APC/C). One variant was c.986A-G (p.Tyr329Cys). In vitro experiments showed that this variant led to a decrease in CDC23 protein level.
quotes: we identified two homozygous missense variants (c.986A > G, p.Y329C and c.988C > T, p.R330C) in CDC23
In vitro experiments showed that the variant c.986A > G (p.Y329C) led to a decrease in CDC23 protein level

findings.statement: Fan et al. (2023) identified a homozygous c.988C-T (p.Arg330Cys) missense variant in the CDC23 gene in women with female infertility characterized by oocyte maturation defects. The variant changed the localization of CDC23 in HeLa cells and mouse oocytes.
quotes: we identified two homozygous missense variants (c.986A > G, p.Y329C and c.988C > T, p.R330C) in CDC23
the variant c.988C > T (p.R330C) changed the localization of CDC23 in HeLa cells and mouse oocytes

findings.statement: Fan et al. (2023) found that Cdc23 Y329C/Y329C knockin mice mimicked the patients' phenotype. Their oocytes had low expression of CDC23 and APC4 and accumulated securin and cyclin B1. Treatment with AZ3146 rescued the phenotype.
quotes: In vivo studies showed that Cdc23Y329C/Y329C mice successfully mimicked the patients' phenotype by causing low expression of CDC23 and APC4 and the accumulation of securin and cyclin B1 in oocytes.
AZ3146 treatment was able to rescue the phenotype.
